nodD_design_choices.scope: All 24-sector/facet phases, module bounds, gaps, edge borders, fixed station positions/depth and clearance values. No claim that these reproduce installed ATLAS dimensions.
All finite frame/port/foot dimensions, topology, alloy density and mu_r=1 proxies, floor level, section sizes and material assumptions. No chamber or magnet weight inferred from envelope volume.
Full-sphere grids and independent iid integration, fixed seeds, geometry-only station counts.

inferences: Literal uninterrupted 4pi coverage is incompatible with the beam opening. The full 4pi denominator remains mandatory; further losses are computed, not silently removed.
Full-depth traversal of a border-inset convex chamber is stricter than a measurement-plane footprint. Neither is detector efficiency.
Finite full-volume separation and material contact connectivity are necessary but insufficient engineering checks.
Vacuum field remains inherited only under the explicit nonmagnetic support proxy; installed HCAL/steel field and chamber response are not recalculated.
Periodic image grids can alias narrow module gaps. Independent iid solid-angle integration supplies headline fractions and sampling errors, excluding geometry uncertainty.
verification: Primary publisher chapters inspected through web tools; selected locators crosschecked by MuonTech/SysArch. No public PDF bytes redistributed. Catalogue PDF hash is a different earlier acquisition and is not asserted equal to the inspected chapter URLs.
